name: healthcare-crm
description: MedixPro Healthcare CRM - run backend (port 5000) and frontend (port 3000) together

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:remote: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:remote --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
